title: Malaysian Noodle Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy stir-fry made with Malaysian noodles, savory free sauce, and a hint of sweetness from dates.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the free sauce and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the dates and stir-fry for 1 minute.
